tasks.title: D67 part 1 — the page and the bridge accept set_partial, rendered as one series marker
tasks.description: Land the transport half of S-P25-2 so the emitter P25-T2 adds cannot be rejected by an unknown op (AR-P25-3). Page: envelope.js::validateOp accepts {"op":"set_partial","ts":<int>,"partial":<bool>} as a directive with no series/cols; chart.js::applyOps lifts it before describeOp (mirroring the set_visible_range branch), keeps one marked time in closure state, and re-applies one guarded createSeriesMarkers(candleSeries, [...]) entry after every rows application. Bridge: _check_op_shape accepts the directive and apply_ops_to_bars ignores it explicitly. Do NOT restructure _stage/flush (P25-T4 owns the emission order), do NOT change mergeRows (P25-T4 owns its whitespace rule) and do not touch ENVELOPE_VERSION, COALESCE_MS, LIVE_OPS or CHANNELS.
acceptance_criteria: Given the page's validateOp/validateEnvelope (chart_assets/lwc/envelope.js), When {"op":"set_partial","ts":<int>,"partial":<bool>} is validated, Then it is accepted as a directive carrying no series and no cols key, and an op with a missing or non-integer ts, a non-boolean partial, or any series/cols key is rejected with a non-null message, while an unknown op kind still rejects the whole envelope.

Given the page's applyOps (chart_assets/lwc/chart.js), When set_partial {ts, partial:true} is applied, Then exactly one series marker exists for that candle -- position "aboveBar", shape "circle", and the one named colour constant whose value differs from LW_UP_COLOR and LW_DOWN_COLOR -- and that marker is re-applied after every later rows application: a set_bars replace, an update_bar upsert, and a full re-apply of the op log.

Given the page's applyOps, When set_partial {ts:A, partial:false} is applied, Then the marker is cleared only when A equals the marked time; a second partial:true for a different ts moves the single mark (never two marks at once); a mark whose time is absent from the current rows is not applied; and no marker exists when no directive has arrived.

Given ui/lwc_bridge.py, When _check_op_shape validates a set_partial op, Then it requires an integer ts and a boolean partial and rejects any series/cols key with ValueError, while apply_ops_to_bars over an op list containing set_partial returns exactly the same [(ts, open, high, low, close)] list as the same list without it (the directive carries no series, so the reconstruction is unchanged, and the docstring says so).

RED before the change (validateOp currently rejects any kind it does not enumerate).

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the page's applyOps, When set_partial {ts:A, partial:false} is applied, Then the marker is cleared only when A equals the marked time; a second partial:true for a different ts moves the single mark (never two marks at once); a mark whose time is absent from the current rows is not applied; and no marker exists when no directive has arrived.

contracts.signature: partial: bool = field(default=False, compare=False, repr=False)  # transient, presentation-only, never persisted
def adopt_period_base(self, bar) -> None:  # sets the open candle's OHLCV from one rendered period row, first_ts = period_start, records base-derived; leaves _last_pushed_ts untouched
def drop_period_base(self) -> None:  # clears a base-derived state only

@property
def covering_since(self) -> int:  # the earliest bar folded into the open candle (first_ts)
_AggState.first_ts: int  # written as ts in push() where the state is created; period_start when adopted
def first_session_open(period_start: int, now_ts: int, ext_hours: bool) -> int | None:  # first ET session open in [period_start, now_ts], holiday-aware; None before any open
_wall_now: Callable[[], int]  # default time.time; assigned at session creation as lambda: self._now_ts()
partial = agg.covering_since > first_session_open(agg.period_start, now_ts, ext_hours)  # stamped on the forming Bar for '1 week'/'1 month' with the load's mode; False for every other timeframe
_partial_ts: int | None  # emits {"op": "set_partial", "ts": <int>, "partial": <bool>} after the rows when the forming bar's (ts, partial) differs from the mark

tasks.title: D68 — a pop-out releases at most the one RT hold it acquired
tasks.description: Move the acquisition state from attach's local into a pop-out-local latch (S-P25-4). PopoutChartWindow gains self._hold_acquired (True only on the else branch where ensure_rt_subscribed() returned) and self._closed (set first in detach, consulted by _retry_rt_subscribe); attach's unwind reads the attribute instead of the local, detach releases only when it is set and then clears it, and a retry that fires after close acquires nothing. TickerSession.ensure_rt_subscribed / release_rt / _rt_holders and every signature stay frozen — tests/test_p13_hold_fix.py fences them. Comment each write site with D68 and state the P13 fence reason.
acceptance_criteria: Given a main chart holding one RT hold and a pop-out whose ensure_rt_subscribed() raised PacingExceeded, When the pop-out is closed before its retry fires, Then no release happens: the session's holder count equals its pre-open value, the fake realtime manager records no unsubscribe for the main reqId, and the pop-out's own _hold_acquired is False.
Given a pop-out that acquired its hold, When it closes, Then exactly one release_rt is recorded, _hold_acquired is cleared, and a second detach() releases nothing further.

Given two pop-outs on the same symbol, one of them pacing-deferred, When they are closed in either order, Then the holder count returns to its pre-open value, closing one while the main chart stays open leaves the main's hold intact, and no window releases a hold it never acquired.

Given a deferred pop-out closed before its retry fires, When _retry_rt_subscribe runs, Then it returns without calling ensure_rt_subscribed (the closed latch), so the subscribe and unsubscribe logs are unchanged by the retry.

Given the main chart is closed first, When the pop-out's hold is the only one left, Then the subscription stays live (no unsubscribe for its reqId) until the pop-out closes, at which point exactly one release is recorded.

Given the phase's change, When tests/test_p13_hold_fix.py runs, Then the session hold API is still a plain integer refcount with ["self"] parameters and no acquire_rt / release_rt_for / _rt_owners, and PopoutChartWindow.attach/detach/closeEvent signatures are unchanged.

tasks.title: D69 + D70 — arrival-ordered flush with one replace per series, and one whitespace rule on both sides
tasks.description: Stamp every staged op with a monotonic sequence and emit data ops in arrival order (S-P25-5): per series keep only the last full replace (set_bars / set_volume / clear) and drop that series' ops with a smaller seq, then append the non-series directives (set_visible_range, set_partial) in arrival order. _op_log, replay_log and the counters keep plain arrival order. Apply the whitespace rule in both reconstruction branches (S-P25-6): apply_ops_to_bars's update_bar branch removes a None-close ts and writes nothing; envelope.js::mergeRows skips a whitespace row on set_bars/set_volume and deletes that time on update_bar; chart.js::upsertRow sends {time} only for a whitespace row.
